removed_text.P253: Data availability. The processed building exposure inventory (585,033 records), district-level loss panels and index series generated in this study are available at [Zenodo DOI to be assigned]. Source data: IBTrACS v4r01 from NOAA NCEI (https://doi.org/10.25921/82ty-9e16); FABDEM V1-2 from the University of Bristol data repository; LandScan population grids from Oak Ridge National Laboratory (https://doi.org/10.48690/1524213); ETOPO 2022 from NOAA NCEI (https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74); housing price data from [data provider, with access conditions]. Code availability. All model code is implemented in Python using the CLIMADA platform (https://github.com/CLIMADA-project/climada_python) and is available at [GitHub repository, release version], including the fixed random seed (42) configuration for full reproducibility.
